title: Fuzzer: `VisibleOnScreenEnabler3D` leaks memory in Godot
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.8.dev.custom_build (2c089e9bf)

### System information

Ubuntu 26.04

### Issue description

```
=== STDOUT ===
Godot Engine v4.8.dev.custom_build.2c089e9bf (2026-07-10 21:18:15 UTC) - https://godotengine.org

=== STDERR ===
ERROR: 3 RID allocations of type 'N10RendererRD18VisibilityNotifierE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: Leaked instance dependency: Bug - did not call instance_notify_deleted when freeing.
   at: ~Dependency (servers/rendering/storage/utilities.cpp:56)
WARNING: Leaked instance dependency: Bug - did not call instance_notify_deleted when freeing.
   at: ~Dependency (servers/rendering/storage/utilities.cpp:56)
WARNING: Leaked instance dependency: Bug - did not call instance_notify_deleted when freeing.
   at: ~Dependency (servers/rendering/storage/utilities.cpp:56)
ERROR: 3 RID allocations of type 'N17RendererSceneCull8InstanceE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: 3 ObjectDB instances were leaked at exit (run with `--verbose` for details).
   at: cleanup (core/object/object.cpp:2536)

```

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

const _FRAMES_TARGET := 3
var _qf := 0

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable20 = VisibleOnScreenEnabler3D.new()

	_qf += 1
	if _qf >= 3:
		get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```
